title: NotionSyncRecord
description: App DB SSOT for Notion Mission Registry projection. Separate state machine from Intake readiness and Mission status. C-01 verified write fields required before claiming external_verified.

mission_id.description: App DB owned; maps 1:1 to missions.id

notion_page_id.description: Present only after successful readback; reused on retry — never create a second page for the same mission_id + source_record_version

sync_status.description: not_started=no projection enqueued; pending=awaiting write/readback; synced=verified external; mock_synced=dev-only (MUST NOT present as Notion verified); failed=retryable; conflict=source_record_version diverged after sync (reserved)

sync_attempt_id.description: Id for the current/last Notion projection attempt

verified_by.description: Actor who authorized projection (operator:<id>); never chatgpt alone

verification_version.description: Policy/schema version string used at verify time

source_record_version.description: Mission revision (and intake version) at verify time; invalidate verification if mission content changes

policy_decision_id.description: Mapping/Handling gate result id or joined policy decision refs
